elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: No professional and workmanlike performance standard is stated; Section 16.1(A) only addresses the capability of M&I's computer systems.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: Reports are warranted to be in substantial conformity with the customer bulletins and User Manuals, and the added language expressly identifies Section 16.1(B) as a warranty.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The clause provides no software-to-documentation warranty and no 12-month software warranty period.
The guaranteed post-performance period for each Service is only 30 days, not 90 days; Term-long coverage does not guarantee 90 days following every Service.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: M&I must promptly repair or replace non-conforming Services or reports.
At Customer's election, M&I must refund fees paid for non-conforming Services or reports.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No warranty of compliance with applicable laws is included.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The 90-day conformity warranty applies to reports against bulletins and User Manuals, not to software against its documentation; Section 16.1(A) only warrants system capability.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: The warranties remain effective for at least 30 days following performance of each Service.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: M&I must promptly repair or replace non-conforming Services or reports.
Customer may elect a refund of fees paid for non-conforming Services or reports.
